reviews.title: Decent
reviews.text: This is a decent game, I find it very fun to play. but, there is a few scams going on. In the pub I count clicks. I’ll have a legendary left side, 2 rare. Iwhen I should get a legendary hero, it clicks a 3rd time to skip it, if it lands on a lower hero I get it. Gives me a rare, or normal. Also this game only lets you go so far becomes impassable by F2P players. There is an issue with hero ag, my hero will run 2 screen widths over to attack a mod. Even when I can not see them. Instead of farming where I put them, I get it if the mobs are on screen, not in this case. Also the respawn time in some areas is too fast your unable to harvest trees or crystals. Especially in the poison area, fighting the boss spider. Basically you have to pay to move any farther. I appreciate the work that was put into the game it’s very well done. Play style and graphics are very well done.

reviews.title: Nice game but there’s some issues
reviews.text: Overall the game is really nice time consumer. The issues come up in some of the outer lying areas. Such as the afk rewards and hero auto selection. The afk rewards does not give you any tool tips on how to increase them but has a link to the tower and you would think hitting higher tower levels would increase them but they don’t seem too. I went from 50 to 100 just to see and yea nothing. The second one is the hero auto selection on the main screen doesn’t select your highest power characters. Only your highest grade characters. Half my team is purple and the other half is gold. Yet if I try to auto select the team it just goes with all gold even though I have purples that are far stronger by several 1k power points.

reviews.title: Great game to idle
reviews.text:
Wonderful design and simplicity make this game such a pleasure to play and I would recommend this to any casual player. 

The only reason I don't give it 5 stars is it has time locked content which you can only access on certain days and unlocking your final character slot is only a temporary thing which really removes the joy of placing high in an event. You win character frames that unlock things like the last character slot, extra xp, boss damage, but the expire frame expires after a week so back to the grind you constantly go. Considering all things good get busy this means you'll always be spending more resource the next time to achieve the same goal vs more contenders so it just becomes a pay to win wall. 

Cheers for the rest though, this is such a wonderful game.
